answer_3.quote: Inspired by , we design a definition accuracy evaluator using LLMs to assess whether each generated or annotated example correctly expresses the intended sense. Specifically, we build a two-step Chain-of-Thought evaluator based on DeepSeek-v3-0324 to estimate the semantic alignment between an example sentence s i and a given lemma-definition pair (l i , d i ).
